title: persona.consumption.recorded.v1
description: A third-reference consumption event: a human or an agent consumed a playlist/media item. The persona-thirdref consumer joins this against Supabase enrichment (resonance domains, persona signals, curriculum tracks) and emits shape.trace.recorded.v1 so personas enrich from shared consumption — the third reference source for persona grounding after authored config and observed interaction.

consumer_kind.description: Which body of the three-body system consumed. Humans carry user_id; agents carry agent_id.

agent_id.description: Agent consumer identity — matches agent_signatures.yaml agent_id (required when consumer_kind=agent)

item_kind.description: What was consumed. youtube_video joins the enrichment columns on pmoves_core.youtube_videos; beat joins the BPM/CLAP beats metadata; generic carries caller-provided resonance_domains.

item_id.description: Identifier of the consumed item (video id, track filename, or free-form key)

source.description: Where the event came from (jellyfin, cli, pipeline, jellyfin-bridge)

duration_seconds.description: How much of the item was consumed; 0/absent means unmeasured

resonance_domains.description: Caller-provided domains; used as-is when item_kind=generic, merged with joined domains otherwise
